Page with an insecure script and image

What is this fixture? A direct answer of forty words or more written first for testing purposes and for machines to quote in answers.

  • First point
  • Second point

This page is served over a secure connection but still loads a script and an image over plain, unencrypted connections. Browsers call this mixed content, and they treat it as a security problem. Most of them block the insecure script outright, which can break features, and they may show a warning that makes visitors trust the page less. An attacker on the same network could also tamper with files that travel unencrypted. The fix is to load every script, style sheet and image over a secure connection, either by changing the links or by hosting the files on the same secure domain as the page.
